description: Add a Help/Onboarding panel and improve the Settings page to be more organized and user-friendly. CSC operators are often non-technical users who need guidance on how to use the platform effectively.
steps: Create frontend/src/components/Common/HelpPanel.jsx - a slide-out panel (from right side) triggered by a floating help button (? icon). Contains: (1) Getting Started checklist (Upload Documents, Add Candidates, Create First Job, Connect WhatsApp). (2) Quick tips section with collapsible FAQ items. (3) Contact support link. Use framer-motion AnimatePresence for slide animation. Use a fixed-position button at bottom-right of screen.
Add the HelpPanel component to DashboardLayout.jsx so it appears on all dashboard pages.

Refactor frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx to organize settings into clear tabbed sections using simple state-based tabs (not a new dependency): (1) Profile tab - center name, owner info, location. (2) Integrations tab - WhatsApp, network status. (3) Preferences tab - dark mode toggle, notification preferences. (4) Team tab - operator management (add/remove operators). Each tab should have a clear header and description.

Add a dark mode toggle that is more prominent and accessible - render it as a sun/moon icon button in the Header.jsx (next to notifications) so users can easily switch themes without going to Settings.
acceptance_criteria: Help panel opens/closes with smooth animation from a floating button
Help panel contains a getting-started checklist and FAQ items
Settings page has clear tab navigation with 4 sections
Dark mode toggle appears in the Header as an icon button
Dark mode toggle uses the existing toggleDarkMode from the store
All components use only existing dependencies (framer-motion, lucide-react, zustand)
verification: Read HelpPanel.jsx to verify animation and content structure
Read modified DashboardLayout.jsx to confirm HelpPanel integration
Read modified Settings.jsx to confirm tabbed layout
Read modified Header.jsx to confirm dark mode toggle button
